claims.claim: The built-in outcome recipe proves the exact normal user job and rejects proxy-only evidence.
claims.claim_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow outcome-journey validation and proxy rejection
claims.journey_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow outcome-journey validation and proxy rejection
claims.actor: Project Workflow maintainer reviewing an active full-contract Epic
claims.starting_state: EPIC-014 has approved Intent, decomposed child plans and a sourced audit.
material_operations: Inspect the current intent audit through the normal Epic CLI.
Validate a claim-matched normal journey record.
Submit preview plus one canary as a proxy for the broader authoring job.
claims.resulting_state_or_artifact: The valid journey is outcome-proven and the green proxy is changes-requested.
outcome_observations: All journey identity and observation fields validate.
Scope mismatch, debug entry and substitute-only evidence are rejected.
claims.environment: Local repository self-hosted workflow CLI and sanitized deterministic fixtures

claims.claim: Intent-adversarial QA requests changes when all derived ACs could pass but the approved user job remains undone.
claims.claim_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow intent-adversarial QA decision
claims.journey_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow intent-adversarial QA decision
claims.actor: Fresh QA reviewer assessing the implemented workflow candidate
claims.normal_entry_point: QA and Code Review section plus normal Epic completion gate
claims.starting_state: Implementation evidence is green and the current parent Intent audit is available.
material_operations: Compare AC evidence with the approved Intent and outcome journey.
Answer whether all ACs could pass while the user job remains undone.
Attempt completion with a Yes or unknown adversarial answer.
claims.resulting_state_or_artifact: The green-but-wrong candidate receives Changes requested and cannot complete.
outcome_observations: The adversarial QA fields are required by current templates.
A Yes or unknown answer fails the completion contract.
claims.environment: Local repository self-hosted workflow CLI and sanitized QA fixtures

claims.claim: Status and lifecycle keep implementation, outcome proof, owner acceptance and delivery as distinct states.
claims.claim_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow proof and authority state projection
claims.journey_scope: self-hosted Project Workflow proof and authority state projection
claims.actor: Owner or maintainer inspecting work status
claims.starting_state: A passing outcome journey requires owner acceptance that is still pending.
material_operations: Record owner acceptance and inspect status again.
claims.resulting_state_or_artifact: Outcome-proven, ready-for-owner-acceptance, owner-accepted and delivery remain distinguishable.
outcome_observations: Pending acceptance does not become owner-accepted.
Completion blocks while required owner acceptance is pending.
Delivery remains a separate operational projection.
claims.environment: Local repository self-hosted workflow CLI and sanitized lifecycle fixtures
